question: Which pair is correctly matched?

A.text: Second Plan — Liberalised Exchange Rate Management System
A.reason: Second Plan predates India's 1992 LERMS introduction; not a Second Plan programme.
A.verification_limit: The LERMS introduction date was not independently verified against an RBI primary timeline in this audit; do not mark this distractor independently primary-source certified.

B.reason: Aspirational Blocks Programme is a modern NITI Aayog initiative, not a Seventh Plan programme.
B.verification_limit: A primary NITI launch document was not independently opened in this audit.

C.text: Eleventh Plan — Faster and more inclusive growth
C.reason: Planning Commission's 2006 approach paper explicitly uses 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'; government-hosted Eleventh Plan Volume I (2007–12) is entitled 'Inclusive Growth'.

D.text: Twelfth Plan — Creation of the Planning Commission
D.reason: The Twelfth Plan was 2012–17, while the Planning Commission was established decades earlier.
D.verification_limit: The Planning Commission's founding government resolution was not directly opened in this audit.

source_access: NITI-hosted digital library catalogue records and government Planning Commission archive were inspected; the full 67 MB Eleventh Plan PDF was not independently page-by-page audited.
